reviews.comment: The 280 GSM cotton drape feels substantial without ever feeling stiff. Collar holds its shape cleanly after multiple washes.
Effortless cut and genuinely breathable linen. The hidden pockets make it my go-to daytime piece.
Zero break-in time. The suede heel trim and off-white leather pair effortlessly with tailored trousers and denim.
Structured enough to stand on its own on my studio floor and comfortably carries my 16-inch laptop plus sketchbook.
